id: W:garcia|ensaio sobre a historia politica e administrativa do brasil
original_title: Ensaio sôbre a história política e administrativa do Brasil (1500-1810)
note: Posthumous first edition, José Olympio, 1956 (Documentos brasileiros, 84). No candidates; identity confirmed in library catalogue, but LCCN/ISBN/OCLC could not be confirmed.

original_title: Ao sul da história: lavradores pobres na crise do trabalho escravo
note: First published as Hebe Maria Mattos de Castro, Brasiliense, 1987; citation is the revised and expanded FGV second edition, 2009. OCLC identifies that cited edition; no candidates.

id: W:gay|experiencia burguesa da rainha vitoria a freud
original_title: The bourgeois experience: Victoria to Freud
note: Portuguese translation of the five-volume work begun in 1984; cited volume unspecified. Candidate records the work under its collective title.

original_title: La colonisation de l'imaginaire: sociétés indigènes et occidentalisation dans le Mexique espagnol, XVIe-XVIIIe siècle
note: Portuguese translation of the 1988 French book. Prefer the French original over the English translation w-320146.

original_title: Literatura e sociedade
note: Facina’s separate 2004 Zahar introduction (56 pages), not Santos e canalhas or Acari cultural.

original_title: Tropical Versailles: Empire, Monarchy, and the Portuguese Royal Court in Rio de Janeiro, 1808-1821
note: Versalhes tropical (Civilização Brasileira, 2008; translated by Renato Aguiar) is the Portuguese translation of this 2001 Routledge book. No candidates.

original_title: Fragmentos da história intelectual: entre questionamentos e perspectivas
note: Helenice Rodrigues da Silva’s Papirus book, 2002; shortened citation omits subtitle. ISBN confirmed in the EPSJV library catalogue; no candidates.

original_title: De la division du travail social
note: The cited Portuguese 1999 edition and the graph’s English edition translate the same 1893 French work; no French original candidate is supplied.

original_title: História dos Estados Unidos: das origens ao século XXI
note: Contexto, 2007; coauthored by Leandro Karnal, Sean Purdy, Luiz Estevam Fernandes and Marcus Vinícius de Morais. No candidates.

original_title: Repensando a história comparada da América Latina
note: Likely this Prado article: the supplied title is its journal rather than its article title. Author and year agree, but the fragment alone cannot establish identity; none of the candidate books matches.

original_title: Trabalho, lar e botequim: o cotidiano dos trabalhadores no Rio de Janeiro da belle époque
note: Citation retains only the ending of the subtitle. Chalhoub and 2001 identify the Unicamp second edition of the 1986 book; publisher preview confirms both editions.

original_title: Le mythe de l'éternel retour: archétypes et répétition
note: Portuguese translation of the 1949 French book. Prefer the original w-200823 over The myth of the eternal return and Cosmos and history.

original_title: Uma história dos conceitos: problemas teóricos e práticos
note: Published Portuguese transcription/translation by Manoel Luiz Salgado Guimarães of a German lecture delivered in Siegen, 12 June 1991. No separately published German original established; none of the candidates is this article. Publisher endpoint returned HTTP 429; citation corroborated in FGV repository.

original_title: Les quatre parties du monde: histoire d'une mondialisation
note: Portuguese translation published jointly by Editora UFMG and Edusp in 2014, of the 2004 French original.

original_title: Imperializm, kak noveĭshiĭ ėtap kapitalizma: populi͡arnyĭ ocherk
note: Portuguese translation of Lenin’s book first published in 1917. Prefer the earliest Russian-language candidate (1923) over later Russian and translated editions; title later commonly uses vysshaia stadiia.

original_title: Devant le temps: histoire de l'art et anachronisme des images
note: Diante do tempo (Editora UFMG, 2015) translates Devant le temps (2000); distinct from Devant l’image.

id: W:milliet|roteiro do cafe e outros ensaios
original_title: Roteiro do café e outros ensaios: contribuição para o estudo da história econômica e social do Brasil
note: The 1982 Hucitec/INL edition republishes the book represented by the 1939 candidate; no translation or different work.

original_title: Ἰλιάς (Ilias)
note: The 1924 citation is consistent with A. T. Murray’s Loeb translation. Match the complete Greek text, Homeri Ilias (Allen, 1931), rather than selections or combined Iliad/Odyssey collections. Ancient composition date uncertain (approximately eighth century BCE).

original_title: Ἑλλάδος περιήγησις (Description of Greece)
note: Pausanias’s second-century CE work; 1918 is W. H. S. Jones’s Loeb translation, beginning with books I–II. ISBN identifies that first volume/its reprints, not an ancient edition; no candidates.

id: W:fishwick|imperial cult in the latin west
original_title: The Imperial Cult in the Latin West: Studies in the Ruler Cult of the Western Provinces of the Roman Empire
note: D. is Duncan Fishwick. Multivolume Brill monograph issued 1987–2005; citation uses the collective title and starting year. LCCN identifies the collective record; no candidates.
